_recovery_const(_key text).name: _recovery_const
_recovery_const(_key text).justification: Reads one tuning constant from recovery_constants, which is G2 shared reference data with no school_id and no per-student content — reach is 'none' because it returns nobody's data. Granted to authenticated because client-side screens need the same thresholds the server uses, and §10 requires exactly one home for each; a second copy in a component is what the rule forbids. Raises rather than defaulting when a key is absent: a trigger count silently defaulting to 0 would fire on every chapter.

It compares the presented bearer token to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and returns 403 to everything else, so no user role reaches it. Was dpp-generate-questions with readerSet public and a teacher/admin/principal role gate, which was right for a teacher pressing generate and wrong for a worker that spends money per call.
